card.subtitle: Two households combined · data day 10-21

cash.explain: Member accounts' cash (broker TotalCashValue, USD) summed. Large figure: share of net value; small: amount; same-day data needed. Negative cash is margin borrowing, shown as such.
cash.label: Cash

day_change.explain: Latest Flex daily total minus the previous report day's, summed over members, USD. Includes deposits and transfers, so not pure return. Percentage is over the previous US trading day's total.
day_change.label: Previous trading day

month_to_date.explain: Month change (month-end total minus month-start total minus deposits, USD) over the month-start total; simple method, not time-weighted. Month starts 2026-10-01. Deposit timing ignored.
month_to_date.label: Month to date (excl. deposits and withdrawals)

net_worth.explain: Member accounts' net liquidation (broker NetLiquidation, USD) summed, latest after-close snapshot; hidden if a member lacks one or times are far apart. Non-USD uses the ledger rate, hence ≈.
net_worth.label: Net value
